profile.name: Agricultural and Environmental Development Cooperative Association – Gaza
profile.about:
The Agricultural and Environmental Development Cooperative Association – Gaza (CAADE) is an independent Palestinian cooperative with legal personality and financial and administrative independence. It is registered with the Ministry of Labour’s Cooperative Work Sector under No. 1696. Founded on 29 December 2021, it began operations in 2022 through the initiative of professionals in agricultural development, cooperative action, environmental management, and humanitarian and development projects.

CAADE advances social solidarity and cooperative action to strengthen resilience, self-reliance, justice, and participation. It connects production and services with value chains, processing, and marketing. Its programmes combine humanitarian response and early recovery with sustainable agricultural and environmental development, including food security, agricultural recovery, livelihoods, natural resource management, smart agriculture, climate adaptation, training, extension services, and the rehabilitation of agricultural and water infrastructure.

The Association serves members and non-members, prioritising farmers, women, young people, and households facing heightened vulnerability and hardship. Its work focuses on North Gaza Governorate. It has 28 members, including 21 founding members. The seven-member Board of Directors was elected by the General Assembly on 20 August 2025 for a term ending on 20 August 2028.

The General Assembly approved administrative and financial reports for 2022–2025. CAADE works with national and international institutions on food security, livelihoods, agricultural development, humanitarian response, and recovery.
profile.vision: A leading cooperative association that promotes the resilience and empowerment of members and the community and provides an innovative and advanced cooperative model for sustainable agricultural development.
profile.mission: We are a cooperative association for agricultural development and the environment, working to strengthen our institutional capacities and serve members and the community by developing innovative cooperative economic models based on modern value chains and techniques, implementing sustainable development programmes within the framework of the social and solidarity economy, seeking to promote justice, participation and interdependence, supporting the sustainability of the agricultural sector and improving the livelihoods of beneficiary families, consistent with national development priorities.
profile.values: Justice and equal opportunities; transparency and accountability; excellence and quality; innovation; sustainability; solidarity and cooperation; partnership; empowerment and participation.
profile.address: Beach Camp, Gaza, Palestine — near Al-Sitt Sura School and opposite the Al-Waleed Home building
profile.heroIntro: A Palestinian cooperative advancing sustainable agricultural and environmental development and supporting the resilience of farmers and families in Gaza.

programs.title: Institutional Excellence, Capacity Building, and Good Governance
programs.description: Strengthen institutional, administrative, and financial capacity, governance, transparency, accountability, and staff skills.

programs.title: Sustainable Agricultural Rehabilitation and Development
programs.description: Support agricultural recovery, sustainable production, efficient resource use, infrastructure, food security, and farmers’ resilience.

programs.title: Agricultural Value Chain Development and Cooperative Marketing
programs.description: Develop agricultural value chains, product quality, agro-processing, cooperative marketing, and local product competitiveness.

programs.title: Recovery, Sustainable Livelihoods, and Community Resilience
programs.description: Integrate humanitarian response with early recovery and economic and social empowerment to improve livelihoods and self-reliance.

programs.title: Environmental Management and Climate-Smart Sustainable Agriculture
programs.description: Protect natural resources, reduce climate impacts, and expand climate-smart, sustainable agricultural practices.
